While both candidates were thorough, Candidate B demonstrated a higher level of analytical rigor by including a 'supplemental_evaluations' section. This section provided explicit cross-checks for acceptance test coverage and risk coverage, and a thoughtful analysis of the chosen 'big-bang' strategy's trade-offs. Candidate B's executive summary and overall narrative demonstrate a tighter integration of all plan components. It clearly links the architectural choice (O1), the milestone strategy (big-bang), and the project plan (M1-M7 sequence) into a cohesive whole, whereas Candidate A's components felt more like separate, albeit correct, sections.
